words.definition: clearly noticeable; different from something else

words.zh: 主要的或主要的；擁有或行使對某事物的控制

words.example: The volcano had been dormant for hundreds of years before the eruption last month.

words.definition: something that captures the imagination; exciting
words.example: The dramatic fmish to the game left us speechless.

words.definition: to select or represent something chosen from many sources or places

words.zh: 選擇或代表從許多來源或地方選擇的東西
